scope: Proposition 10.4 (The cap-selected coefficient) of the manuscript “Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Cap-selected-amplitudes-and-triangle-chords-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 63. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix N ≥ N0, homogeneous sites, and 0 ≤ θ ≤ π/2. Evaluate W, J at the real roots of Proposition 9.1 with δ = θ/(2π), and write the quotient as (W/J)θ. Put Fθ(u) = F(u; 0, eiθ). In the cap matrix element with bulk spin twist K−1 = e−iθ, right cap twist i, and left cap twist −i, the eigenvalue selected in Proposition 10.3 is the TQ value Fθ(l). Its coefficient is cphys(θ) = (W/J)θ (W/J)π/2 . (10.5) In particular cphys(π/2) = 1.
